name: @aimino/stas-mcp
description: MCP server for STAS — Solving Tickets As A Service. Submit GitHub issues, list runs, search codebase, and get automated fix PRs via OpenCode agents.

stas_label_issue.description: Label a GitHub issue with the STAS fix label (or custom label).

stas_run_fix.description: Trigger the STAS fix pipeline for a GitHub issue URL.

stas_check_status.description: Check the current status of a STAS fix run by run_id.

stas_get_pr.description: Get the PR URL and details for a completed STAS fix run.

list_issues.description: List tracked issues with their STAS fix status, with optional filters.

search_codebase.description: Search the STAS codebase for symbols, files, or patterns.

stas://runs/{run_id}.description: Full run details including status, timestamps, issue info, and PR link.

stas://issues/{issue_id}.description: Issue details with fix status, run history, and linked PRs.

stdio.description: Stdio transport for local tools like OpenCode and Claude Desktop

sse.description: Server-Sent Events transport for remote MCP communication

streamable-http.description: Streamable HTTP transport for JSON-RPC over HTTP
